actions.action: Condense verified duplicates without merging licensed copies
actions.mechanism: Collapse only matching file hashes, creator IDs, and license records; explicitly marked intentional variants remain separate.
actions.implementation: Precompute group IDs in the existing index. Show expandable member counts and folder paths; retain every file and paginate by groups.
actions.check: Test duplicate files, identical pixels with different licenses, and different crops. Verify correct separation and first-page loading under one second.
actions.risk: Missing license records must prevent automatic grouping.

actions.action: Connect intentional versions without concealing them
actions.mechanism: Explicit, typed relationships explain crops and annotations without treating visual similarity as equivalence.
actions.implementation: Let people link files as crop-of, annotated-from, or intentional-variant. Index direct links; display badges and lazy-load related-file previews without collapsing these results.
actions.check: Link two crops and an annotation to one original. Confirm all remain independently searchable and linked previews retrieve the correct files.
actions.risk: Incorrect human links need reversible edits and attribution.

actions.action: Record the exact licensed file each project used
actions.mechanism: An immutable usage receipt preserves file identity and licensing context independently of search grouping or later relationship changes.
actions.implementation: On project placement or export, record project ID, stable file ID, hash, original path, and a versioned license-record reference. Never select a substitute silently.
actions.check: Use identical-pixel files with different licenses in two projects; verify each receipt resolves its original file and historical license record.
actions.risk: Uninstrumented downloads leave provenance gaps; label missing receipts explicitly.
